name: cf-payroll-social
description: Use this Central African Republic payroll Guide for 2026 research on employee IRPP withholding, monthly versus small-employer remittance and annual employer summaries. It routes the actual salary tax calculation to the individual income Guide and clearly separates tax withholding from CNSS contributions. Search triggers include salary tax, PAYE, employer return, five employees, quarterly remittance, CNSS, social security and payroll cessation. Conflicting old social rates and ceilings are expressly withheld because the official CNSS and Labour Ministry sources could not be opened successfully. The payroll calendar is a conditional code baseline, not a complete operative 2026 payroll or contribution schedule.
